title: Spellforge Garden Static
description: A surreal scene shows a woman in a teal off-shoulder dress standing beside a wooden greenhouse entwined with flowering vines and skulls. Above her floats a large, ornate skull adorned with flowers, butterflies, and glowing lights, its roots dangling downward, while a small wooden boat rests in the foreground.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a woman in a teal off-shoulder vintage dress standing next to a glass greenhouse covered in flowering vines and small skulls. A large ornate skull floats in the sky above, decorated with colorful flowers, butterflies, and glowing orbs, with roots hanging down. A wooden rowboat sits in the foreground among flowers. Text reads SPELLFORGE 825 GARDEN STATIC. Vibrant teal and cyan sky, detailed illustrative style.
